links.outcome: Contraindication classification accuracy with versus without guideline retrieval-augmented generation
links.effect: Baseline accuracy 85.8% to 87.1% improved to 92.5% to 98.4% with RAG (all p < 0.05); weighted kappa rose from 0.885-0.913 to 0.949-0.990.
links.quote: Baseline accuracy ranged from 85.8% to 87.1% across models and improved to 92.5% to 98.4% with RAG (all p < 0.05).

links.outcome: LLM classification accuracy against guideline-derived ground truth, by contraindication type
links.effect: Absolute contraindication catch rates 99.0%-100.0% across all conditions; relative contraindication accuracy only 42.1%-56.1% at baseline, rising to 59.6%-93.0% with RAG.
links.quote: Relative contraindications showed the largest improvements with RAG, increasing from 42.1%-56.1% to 59.6%-93.0%.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance on contraindication screening and specifically compares performance with and without guideline retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
